name: Karoo BBrakers
description: WorldTour-grade Braking Telemetry, Dynamic Load Transfer, Kamm Friction Circle, Dual Rotor Thermal & Fade Safety Monitor and Peloton Feathering for Hammerhead Karoo 2 & Karoo 3.
releaseNotes: Initial WorldTour release: Real-time deceleration gauge (White to Red spectrum), dual front/rear brake bias, Kamm friction circle grip margin, dissipated watts and involuntary brake drag detection, dual rotor heat monitoring, peloton feathering, and full 6-language localization (EN, ES, DE, FR, IT, PT).
